findings.summary: Fixture fix whose test requires required_payload.txt: the developer tree has that file untracked (test exit 0) and a fresh clone at the fix SHA does not (test exit non-zero). Copying the file in by hand makes the clone pass, so it is a missing-commit defect.
Same test with required_payload.txt committed at the fix SHA: developer and clone both exit 0, and clone SHA equals fix SHA. The detector is not always-red.

Product worktree /opt/p2/ast-integrate has no .git object database, so it cannot be cloned at a product fix SHA. CNF-0022 (fix commit list) is also absent. Product-tree fixes are therefore NOT-CHECKED; the load-bearing clone/SHA experiment runs on an isolated fixture repository.
